info.name: IAM Service REST API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for IAM Service based on Spring Authorization Server (OAuth 2.1 / OIDC 1.0). Follows Section D specifications with RFC 9457 Problem Details error responses.

request.description: Registers a new user publicly without authentication.
Requires authority: user:read. Returns active roles, direct permissions, and calculated effective permissions.
Requires authority: user:assign. Effect can be GRANT or DENY.
Requires authority: authenticated. Returns linked social accounts.
Requires authority: authenticated. User cannot unlink their last sign-in method if no password is set.
